  10: _LEGAL_HEADING = re.compile(
  11:     r"^(?:(?P<section>§+\s*\d+[a-zA-Z]*)|"
  12:     r"(?P<article>Artikel\s+\d+[a-zA-Z]*)|"
  13:     r"(?P<number>\d+(?:\.\d+)*\.(?!\d))|"
  14:     r"(?P<paragraph>\(\d+\))|"
  15:     r"(?P<letter>(?:lit\.\s*)?[a-z]\)))\s*",
  16:     re.IGNORECASE,
  17: )
  18: _SENTENCE_BOUNDARY = re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+(?=[A-ZÄÖÜ0-9§(])")
  19: 
  20: 
  21: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  22: class Clause:
  23:     ordinal: int
  24:     heading_path: str | None
  25:     text: str
  26:     clause_hash: str
  27:     is_tenor_relevant: bool = False
  28: 
  29: 
  30: def split_clauses(text: str) -> tuple[Clause, ...]:
  31:     """Split canonical text deterministically, preferring legal structure."""
  32:     canonical = normalize_plain_text(text).rstrip("\n")
  33:     if not canonical:
  34:         return ()
  35:     paragraphs = [line for line in canonical.split("\n") if line]
  36:     if any(_LEGAL_HEADING.match(line) for line in paragraphs):
  37:         chunks = _split_legal(paragraphs)
  38:     else:
  39:         chunks = [(None, part) for paragraph in paragraphs for part in _bounded_blocks(paragraph)]
  40:     return tuple(
  41:         Clause(
  42:             ordinal=index,
  43:             heading_path=heading,
  44:             text=chunk,
  45:             clause_hash=hashlib.sha256(chunk.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
  46:         )
  47:         for index, (heading, chunk) in enumerate(chunks, start=1)
  48:         if chunk
  49:     )
  50: 
  51: 
  52: def _split_legal(paragraphs: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str | None, str]]:
  53:     chunks: list[tuple[str | None, str]] = []
  54:     hierarchy: list[str] = []
  55:     current_heading: str | None = None
  56:     buffer: list[str] = []
  57: 
  58:     def flush() -> None:
  59:         if not buffer:
  60:             return
  61:         combined = "\n".join(buffer)
  62:         chunks.extend((current_heading, part) for part in _bounded_blocks(combined))
  63:         buffer.clear()
  64: 
  65:     for paragraph in paragraphs:
  66:         match = _LEGAL_HEADING.match(paragraph)
  67:         if match:
  68:             flush()
  69:             marker = match.group(0).strip()
  70:             level = _heading_level(match)
  71:             hierarchy[level:] = []
  72:             if len(hierarchy) < level:
  73:                 hierarchy.extend([""] * (level - len(hierarchy)))
  74:             hierarchy.append(marker)
  75:             current_heading = " > ".join(item for item in hierarchy if item)
  76:         buffer.append(paragraph)
  77:     flush()
  78:     return chunks
  79: 
  80: 
  81: def _heading_level(match: re.Match[str]) -> int:
  82:     if match.group("section") or match.group("article"):
  83:         return 0
  84:     if match.group("number"):
  85:         return match.group("number").count(".") - 1
  86:     if match.group("paragraph"):
  87:         return 1
  88:     return 2
  89: 
  90: 
  91: def _bounded_blocks(value: str, minimum: int = 400, maximum: int = 800) -> list[str]:
  92:     if len(value) <= maximum:
  93:         return [value]
  94:     sentences = _SENTENCE_BOUNDARY.split(value.replace("\n", " "))
  95:     blocks: list[str] = []
  96:     current = ""
  97:     for sentence in sentences:
  98:         if len(sentence) > maximum:
  99:             if current:
 100:                 blocks.append(current)
 101:                 current = ""
 102:             blocks.extend(sentence[index : index + maximum] for index in range(0, len(sentence), maximum))
 103:             continue
 104:         candidate = f"{current} {sentence}".strip()
 105:         if current and len(candidate) > maximum and len(current) >= minimum:
 106:             blocks.append(current)
 107:             current = sentence
 108:         else:
 109:             current = candidate
 110:     if current:
 111:         if blocks and len(current) < minimum and len(blocks[-1]) + 1 + len(current) <= maximum:
 112:             blocks[-1] = f"{blocks[-1]} {current}"
 113:         else:
 114:             blocks.append(current)
 115:     return blocks

   1: from __future__ import annotations
   2: 
   3: from dataclasses import dataclass
   4: from difflib import SequenceMatcher
   5: 
   6: from muclegal.normalize.clauses import Clause
   7: 
   8: 
   9: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  10: class ClausePair:
  11:     previous: Clause | None
  12:     current: Clause | None
  13:     similarity: float
  14: 
  15: 
  16: def pair_clause_changes(
  17:     previous: tuple[Clause, ...], current: tuple[Clause, ...]
  18: ) -> tuple[ClausePair, ...]:
  19:     """Pair changed clauses structurally, then by text similarity; omit unchanged hashes."""
  20:     current_hashes = {clause.clause_hash for clause in current}
  21:     previous_hashes = {clause.clause_hash for clause in previous}
  22:     removed = [clause for clause in previous if clause.clause_hash not in current_hashes]
  23:     added = [clause for clause in current if clause.clause_hash not in previous_hashes]
  24:     available = set(range(len(added)))
  25:     pairs: list[ClausePair] = []
  26: 
  27:     for old in removed:
  28:         ranked: list[tuple[float, float, int]] = []
  29:         for index in available:
  30:             new = added[index]
  31:             similarity = SequenceMatcher(None, old.text, new.text).ratio()
  32:             same_heading = bool(old.heading_path and old.heading_path == new.heading_path)
  33:             ordinal_proximity = 1 / (1 + abs(old.ordinal - new.ordinal))
  34:             score = similarity + (0.5 if same_heading else 0.0) + 0.1 * ordinal_proximity
  35:             ranked.append((score, similarity, index))
  36:         if not ranked:
  37:             pairs.append(ClausePair(old, None, 0.0))
  38:             continue
  39:         _, similarity, best_index = max(ranked)
  40:         best = added[best_index]
  41:         structurally_same = (
  42:             old.heading_path == best.heading_path and abs(old.ordinal - best.ordinal) <= 1
  43:         )
  44:         if similarity > 0.5 or structurally_same:
  45:             available.remove(best_index)
  46:             pairs.append(ClausePair(old, best, similarity))
  47:         else:
  48:             pairs.append(ClausePair(old, None, similarity))
  49: 
  50:     pairs.extend(ClausePair(None, added[index], 0.0) for index in sorted(available))
  51:     return tuple(
  52:         sorted(
  53:             pairs,
  54:             key=lambda pair: (
  55:                 pair.current.ordinal if pair.current else pair.previous.ordinal,
  56:                 pair.current is None,
  57:             ),
  58:         )
  59:     )

 625:     def _new_artifact_directory(self, url: str, kind: str) -> Path:
 626:         url_key = hashlib.sha256(url.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
 627:         stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
 628:         path = self.artifacts / url_key / f"{stamp}-{kind}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
 629:         path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
 630:         return path

 185:     def _save_screenshot(self, case_id: str, screenshot: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
 186:         media_type = str(screenshot.get("media_type", "")).lower()
 187:         if media_type not in {"image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/webp"}:
 188:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Screenshot muss PNG, JPEG oder WebP sein.")
 189:         encoded = screenshot.get("data_base64")
 190:         if not isinstance(encoded, str) or not encoded:
 191:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Screenshot-Daten fehlen.")
 192:         try:
 193:             payload = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
 194:         except (binascii.Error, ValueError) as exc:
 195:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Screenshot ist nicht gültig Base64-kodiert.") from exc
 196:         if not payload or len(payload) > 10 * 1024 * 1024:
 197:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Screenshot muss zwischen 1 Byte und 10 MB groß sein.")
 198:         signatures = {
 199:             "image/png": b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n",
 200:             "image/jpeg": b"\xff\xd8\xff",
 201:             "image/webp": b"RIFF",
 202:         }
 203:         if not payload.startswith(signatures[media_type]):
 204:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Dateiinhalt passt nicht zum Screenshot-Medientyp.")
 205:         if media_type == "image/webp" and payload[8:12] != b"WEBP":
 206:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Dateiinhalt ist kein gültiger WebP-Screenshot.")
 207:         suffix = {"image/png": ".png", "image/jpeg": ".jpg", "image/webp": ".webp"}[media_type]
 208:         original = SAFE_NAME.sub("-", str(screenshot.get("filename", "erstverstoss"))).strip(".-")
 209:         name = f"{original or 'erstverstoss'}{suffix}"
 210:         directory = (self.artifact_root / case_id).resolve()
 211:         directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
 212:         path = (directory / name).resolve()
 213:         path.relative_to(self.artifact_root)
 214:         path.write_bytes(payload)
 215:         return str(path), hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()

 218: def validate_case_input(value: dict) -> dict:
 219:     required = (
 220:         "fall_id",
 221:         "domain",
 222:         "source_url",
 223:         "violation_type",
 224:         "description",
 225:         "tenor_element",
 226:         "monitoring_target",
 227:         "relevant_page_types",
 228:     )
 229:     cleaned = dict(value)
 230:     for field in required[:-1]:
 231:         if not isinstance(cleaned.get(field), str) or not cleaned[field].strip():
 232:             raise MonitoringCaseError(f"Pflichtfeld {field!r} fehlt.")
 233:         cleaned[field] = cleaned[field].strip()
 234:     page_types = cleaned.get("relevant_page_types")
 235:     if not isinstance(page_types, list) or not page_types or not all(
 236:         isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in page_types
 237:     ):
 238:         raise MonitoringCaseError("Mindestens ein relevanter Seitentyp ist erforderlich.")
 239:     cleaned["relevant_page_types"] = [item.strip() for item in page_types]
 240:     if cleaned["violation_type"] not in VIOLATION_TYPES:
 241:         raise MonitoringCaseError("Verstoßtyp muss 'klausel' oder 'element' sein.")
 242: 
 243:     domain_host = _host(cleaned["domain"])
 244:     source_host = _host(cleaned["source_url"])
 245:     allowed = cleaned.get("allowed_subdomains", [])
 246:     if not isinstance(allowed, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in allowed):
 247:         raise MonitoringCaseError("allowed_subdomains muss eine Liste von Hostnamen sein.")
 248:     allowed_hosts = tuple(sorted({_host(item) for item in allowed if item.strip()}))
 249:     if source_host != domain_host and source_host not in allowed_hosts:
 250:         raise MonitoringCaseError("Fundstellen-URL muss zur Domain oder freigegebenen Subdomain gehören.")
 251:     cleaned["domain"] = domain_host
 252:     cleaned["allowed_subdomains"] = list(allowed_hosts)
 253: 
 254:     if cleaned["violation_type"] == "klausel":
 255:         clause_text = str(cleaned.get("clause_text") or "").strip()
 256:         if not clause_text:
 257:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Bei Klauselverstößen ist der beanstandete Wortlaut erforderlich.")
 258:         cleaned["clause_text"] = clause_text
 259:         cleaned.update(element_label=None, element_function=None, element_error=None)
 260:     else:
 261:         for field in ("element_label", "element_function", "element_error"):
 262:             if not isinstance(cleaned.get(field), str) or not cleaned[field].strip():
 263:                 raise MonitoringCaseError(f"Bei Elementverstößen ist {field!r} erforderlich.")
 264:             cleaned[field] = cleaned[field].strip()
 265:         if cleaned["element_error"] not in ELEMENT_ERRORS:
 266:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Unbekannte Fehlerart für das erwartete Element.")
 267:         cleaned["clause_text"] = None
 268:     return cleaned

 271: def _host(value: str) -> str:
 272:     candidate = value.strip()
 273:     parsed = urlsplit(candidate if "://" in candidate else f"https://{candidate}")
 274:     if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username:
 275:         raise MonitoringCaseError("Domain und Fundstelle müssen gültige öffentliche HTTP(S)-Ziele sein.")
 276:     return parsed.hostname.lower().rstrip(".")

 415:         return "manuelle_pruefung_erforderlich"

 425: def canonical_url(value: str) -> str:

 174:                 "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1",
 175:                 "Accept-Language": "de,en;q=0.5",
 176:                 "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
 177:             },
 178:         )
 179:         fetched_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 180:         try:
 181:             with opener.open(req, timeout=self.policy.timeout_seconds) as response:
 182:                 body = response.read()
 183:                 status = response.status
 184:                 headers = tuple(response.headers.items())
 185:                 final_url = response.geturl()
 186:                 decoded = self._decode_body(body, response.headers)
 187:         except error.HTTPError as exc:
 188:             body = exc.read()
 189:             headers = tuple(exc.headers.items()) if exc.headers else ()
 190:             raise FetchFailure(
 191:                 "http_error",
 192:                 f"HTTP-Abruf fehlgeschlagen (Status {exc.code}).",
 193:                 status_code=exc.code,
 194:                 headers=headers,
 195:                 body=body,
 196:                 manual_review=exc.code in {401, 403, 407, 429},
 197:             ) from exc
 198:         except (error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
 199:             raise FetchFailure("network_error", f"HTTP-Abruf fehlgeschlagen: {exc}") from exc
 200: 
 201:         block_reason = _detect_block_page(decoded)
 202:         if block_reason:
 203:             raise FetchFailure(
 204:                 "protected_or_login_page",
 205:                 f"Abruf abgebrochen: {block_reason}",
 206:                 status_code=status,
 207:                 headers=headers,
 208:                 body=body,
 209:                 manual_review=True,
 210:             )
 211:         return FetchResult(
 212:             requested_url=url,
 213:             final_url=final_url,
 214:             fetched_at=fetched_at,
 215:             status_code=status,
 216:             headers=headers,
 217:             redirect_chain=tuple(redirects.chain),
 218:             body=body,
 219:             decoded_html=decoded,
 220:         )

 222:     @staticmethod
 223:     def _decode_body(body: bytes, headers: Message) -> str:
 224:         content_encoding = (headers.get("Content-Encoding") or "").lower()
 225:         if content_encoding == "gzip":
 226:             body = gzip.decompress(body)
 227:         charset = headers.get_content_charset() or "utf-8"
 228:         return body.decode(charset, errors="replace")

 231: def _detect_block_page(html: str) -> str | None:
 232:     sample = html[:500_000].lower()
 233:     captcha_markers = ("g-recaptcha", "hcaptcha", "captcha-container", "cf-chl-")
 234:     if any(marker in sample for marker in captcha_markers) or re.search(
 235:         r"\b(?:verify you are human|captcha)\b", sample
 236:     ):
 237:         return "CAPTCHA oder Bot-Challenge erkannt; manuelle Prüfung erforderlich."
 238:     if re.search(r"<input\b[^>]*\btype\s*=\s*['\"]?password\b", sample):
 239:         return "Login-Seite erkannt; manuelle Prüfung erforderlich."
 240:     if "just a moment" in sample and "cloudflare" in sample:
 241:         return "technische Blockseite erkannt; manuelle Prüfung erforderlich."
 242:     return None

  60: def normalize_html(raw_html: str | bytes, config: NormalizationConfig) -> NormalizedDocument:
  61:     try:

  63:     except (etree.ParserError, ValueError) as exc:

  65:

  70:             raise NormalizationError(
  71:                 f"Include-Selektor {config.include_selector!r} muss genau einmal treffen; "
  72:                 f"gefunden: {len(matches)}."
  73:             )
  74:         root = deepcopy(matches[0])
  75: 
  76:     for selector in ("script", "style", "noscript", "template", *config.remove_selectors):
  77:         for node in _select(root, selector):
  78:             parent = node.getparent()
  79:             if parent is not None:
  80:                 parent.remove(node)
  81: 
  82:     for rule in config.volatile_rules:
  83:         if not rule.marker.startswith("[") or not rule.marker.endswith("]"):
  84:             raise NormalizationError(f"Typisierter Marker erwartet, erhalten: {rule.marker!r}")
  85:         for node in _select(root, rule.selector):
  86:             for child in list(node):
  87:                 node.remove(child)
  88:             node.text = rule.marker
  89: 
  90:     prepared_html = html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode", method="html")
  91:     extracted = extract(
  92:         prepared_html,
  93:         output_format="txt",
  94:         favor_precision=True,
  95:         include_comments=False,
  96:         include_tables=True,
  97:         include_links=False,
  98:         include_images=False,
  99:         with_metadata=False,
 100:         deduplicate=False,

 102:     if not extracted or not extracted.strip():
 103:         raise NormalizationError("Die konfigurierte Extraktion ergab keinen relevanten Text.")
 104:     text = _canonicalize_text(extracted)
 105:     digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 106:     return NormalizedDocument(text, digest, NORMALIZER_VERSION, config.config_hash)

 109: def _select(root: etree._Element, selector: str) -> list[etree._Element]:
 110:     match = _SIMPLE_SELECTOR.fullmatch(selector.strip())
 111:     if not match or not any(match.groupdict().values()):
 112:         raise NormalizationError(
 113:             f"Nicht unterstützter CSS-Selektor {selector!r}; erlaubt sind tag, #id, .klasse und tag.klasse."
 114:         )
 115:     tag = match.group("tag") or "*"
 116:     predicates: list[str] = []
 117:     if match.group("id"):
 118:         predicates.append(f"@id={_xpath_literal(match.group('id'))}")
 119:     if match.group("class"):
 120:         class_name = _xpath_literal(f" {match.group('class')} ")
 121:         predicates.append(f"contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), {class_name})")
 122:     suffix = f"[{' and '.join(predicates)}]" if predicates else ""
 123:     return list(root.xpath(f"descendant-or-self::{tag}{suffix}"))
 124: 
 125: 
 126: def _xpath_literal(value: str) -> str:
 127:     if "'" not in value:
 128:         return f"'{value}'"
 129:     if '"' not in value:
 130:         return f'"{value}"'
 131:     raise NormalizationError("Anführungszeichen sind in einfachen Selektoren nicht zulässig.")

 134: def normalize_plain_text(value: str) -> str:
 135:     """Canonicalize extracted text without removing substantive content."""
 136:     value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n"))
 137:     value = value.translate(
 138:         str.maketrans(
 139:             {
 140:                 "\u00a0": " ",
 141:                 "\u00ad": None,
 142:                 "\u200b": None,
 143:                 "\u200c": None,
 144:                 "\u200d": None,
 145:                 "\ufeff": None,
 146:                 "\u2018": "'",
 147:                 "\u2019": "'",
 148:                 "\u201c": '"',
 149:                 "\u201d": '"',
 150:                 "\u2010": "-",
 151:                 "\u2011": "-",
 152:                 "\u2012": "-",
 153:                 "\u2013": "-",
 154:                 "\u2014": "-",
 155:                 "\u2212": "-",
 156:             }
 157:         )
 158:     )
 159:     lines = [re.sub(r"[\t\f\v ]+", " ", line).strip() for line in value.split("\n")]
 160:     output: list[str] = []
 161:     for line in lines:
 162:         if line or (output and output[-1]):
 163:             output.append(line)
 164:     return "\n".join(output).strip() + "\n"
 165: 
 166: 
 167: def _canonicalize_text(value: str) -> str:
 168:     return normalize_plain_text(value)

  10: _LEGAL_HEADING = re.compile(
  11:     r"^(?:(?P<section>§+\s*\d+[a-zA-Z]*)|"
  12:     r"(?P<article>Artikel\s+\d+[a-zA-Z]*)|"
  13:     r"(?P<number>\d+(?:\.\d+)*\.(?!\d))|"
  14:     r"(?P<paragraph>\(\d+\))|"
  15:     r"(?P<letter>(?:lit\.\s*)?[a-z]\)))\s*",
  16:     re.IGNORECASE,
  17: )
  18: _SENTENCE_BOUNDARY = re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+(?=[A-ZÄÖÜ0-9§(])")
  19: 
  20: 
  21: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  22: class Clause:
  23:     ordinal: int
  24:     heading_path: str | None
  25:     text: str
  26:     clause_hash: str
  27:     is_tenor_relevant: bool = False
  28: 
  29: 
  30: def split_clauses(text: str) -> tuple[Clause, ...]:
  31:     """Split canonical text deterministically, preferring legal structure."""
  32:     canonical = normalize_plain_text(text).rstrip("\n")
  33:     if not canonical:
  34:         return ()
  35:     paragraphs = [line for line in canonical.split("\n") if line]
  36:     if any(_LEGAL_HEADING.match(line) for line in paragraphs):
  37:         chunks = _split_legal(paragraphs)
  38:     else:
  39:         chunks = [(None, part) for paragraph in paragraphs for part in _bounded_blocks(paragraph)]
  40:     return tuple(
  41:         Clause(
  42:             ordinal=index,
  43:             heading_path=heading,
  44:             text=chunk,
  45:             clause_hash=hashlib.sha256(chunk.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
  46:         )
  47:         for index, (heading, chunk) in enumerate(chunks, start=1)
  48:         if chunk
  49:     )
  50: 
  51: 
  52: def _split_legal(paragraphs: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str | None, str]]:
  53:     chunks: list[tuple[str | None, str]] = []
  54:     hierarchy: list[str] = []
  55:     current_heading: str | None = None
  56:     buffer: list[str] = []
  57: 
  58:     def flush() -> None:
  59:         if not buffer:
  60:             return
  61:         combined = "\n".join(buffer)
  62:         chunks.extend((current_heading, part) for part in _bounded_blocks(combined))
  63:         buffer.clear()
  64: 
  65:     for paragraph in paragraphs:
  66:         match = _LEGAL_HEADING.match(paragraph)
  67:         if match:
  68:             flush()
  69:             marker = match.group(0).strip()
  70:             level = _heading_level(match)
  71:             hierarchy[level:] = []
  72:             if len(hierarchy) < level:
  73:                 hierarchy.extend([""] * (level - len(hierarchy)))
  74:             hierarchy.append(marker)
  75:             current_heading = " > ".join(item for item in hierarchy if item)
  76:         buffer.append(paragraph)
  77:     flush()
  78:     return chunks
  79: 
  80: 
  81: def _heading_level(match: re.Match[str]) -> int:
  82:     if match.group("section") or match.group("article"):
  83:         return 0
  84:     if match.group("number"):
  85:         return match.group("number").count(".") - 1
  86:     if match.group("paragraph"):
  87:         return 1
  88:     return 2
  89: 
  90: 
  91: def _bounded_blocks(value: str, minimum: int = 400, maximum: int = 800) -> list[str]:
  92:     if len(value) <= maximum:
  93:         return [value]
  94:     sentences = _SENTENCE_BOUNDARY.split(value.replace("\n", " "))
  95:     blocks: list[str] = []
  96:     current = ""
  97:     for sentence in sentences:
  98:         if len(sentence) > maximum:
  99:             if current:
 100:                 blocks.append(current)
 101:                 current = ""
 102:             blocks.extend(sentence[index : index + maximum] for index in range(0, len(sentence), maximum))
 103:             continue
 104:         candidate = f"{current} {sentence}".strip()
 105:         if current and len(candidate) > maximum and len(current) >= minimum:
 106:             blocks.append(current)
 107:             current = sentence
 108:         else:
 109:             current = candidate
 110:     if current:
 111:         if blocks and len(current) < minimum and len(blocks[-1]) + 1 + len(current) <= maximum:
 112:             blocks[-1] = f"{blocks[-1]} {current}"
 113:         else:
 114:             blocks.append(current)
 115:     return blocks

   1: from __future__ import annotations
   2: 
   3: from dataclasses import dataclass
   4: from difflib import SequenceMatcher
   5: 
   6: from muclegal.normalize.clauses import Clause
   7: 
   8: 
   9: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  10: class ClausePair:
  11:     previous: Clause | None
  12:     current: Clause | None
  13:     similarity: float
  14: 
  15: 
  16: def pair_clause_changes(
  17:     previous: tuple[Clause, ...], current: tuple[Clause, ...]
  18: ) -> tuple[ClausePair, ...]:
  19:     """Pair changed clauses structurally, then by text similarity; omit unchanged hashes."""
  20:     current_hashes = {clause.clause_hash for clause in current}
  21:     previous_hashes = {clause.clause_hash for clause in previous}
  22:     removed = [clause for clause in previous if clause.clause_hash not in current_hashes]
  23:     added = [clause for clause in current if clause.clause_hash not in previous_hashes]
  24:     available = set(range(len(added)))
  25:     pairs: list[ClausePair] = []
  26: 
  27:     for old in removed:
  28:         ranked: list[tuple[float, float, int]] = []
  29:         for index in available:
  30:             new = added[index]
  31:             similarity = SequenceMatcher(None, old.text, new.text).ratio()
  32:             same_heading = bool(old.heading_path and old.heading_path == new.heading_path)
  33:             ordinal_proximity = 1 / (1 + abs(old.ordinal - new.ordinal))
  34:             score = similarity + (0.5 if same_heading else 0.0) + 0.1 * ordinal_proximity
  35:             ranked.append((score, similarity, index))
  36:         if not ranked:
  37:             pairs.append(ClausePair(old, None, 0.0))
  38:             continue
  39:         _, similarity, best_index = max(ranked)
  40:         best = added[best_index]
  41:         structurally_same = (
  42:             old.heading_path == best.heading_path and abs(old.ordinal - best.ordinal) <= 1
  43:         )
  44:         if similarity > 0.5 or structurally_same:
  45:             available.remove(best_index)
  46:             pairs.append(ClausePair(old, best, similarity))
  47:         else:
  48:             pairs.append(ClausePair(old, None, similarity))
  49: 
  50:     pairs.extend(ClausePair(None, added[index], 0.0) for index in sorted(available))
  51:     return tuple(
  52:         sorted(
  53:             pairs,
  54:             key=lambda pair: (
  55:                 pair.current.ordinal if pair.current else pair.previous.ordinal,
  56:                 pair.current is None,
  57:             ),
  58:         )
  59:     )

  75: class HttpFetcher:
  76:     """Conservative HTTP fetcher for public pages only."""
  77: 
  78:     def __init__(self, policy: FetchPolicy | None = None) -> None:
  79:         self.policy = policy or FetchPolicy()
  80: 
  81:     def fetch(self, url: str) -> FetchResult:
  82:         self._validate_url(url)
  83:         if self.policy.respect_robots:
  84:             self._require_robots_permission(url)
  85: 
  86:         last_failure: FetchFailure | None = None
  87:         for attempt in range(1, self.policy.max_attempts + 1):
  88:             try:
  89:                 return self._fetch_once(url)
  90:             except FetchFailure as exc:
  91:                 last_failure = exc
  92:                 if exc.status_code not in RETRYABLE_STATUS or attempt == self.policy.max_attempts:
  93:                     raise
  94:                 time.sleep(self.policy.retry_backoff_seconds * (2 ** (attempt - 1)))
  95:         assert last_failure is not None
  96:         raise last_failure

  98:     def _validate_url(self, url: str) -> None:
  99:         parsed = parse.urlsplit(url)
 100:         if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.hostname:
 101:             raise FetchFailure("invalid_url", "Nur öffentliche HTTP(S)-URLs sind zulässig.")
 102:         if parsed.username or parsed.password:
 103:             raise FetchFailure(
 104:                 "credentials_in_url",
 105:                 "URLs mit Zugangsdaten werden nicht abgerufen.",
 106:                 manual_review=True,
 107:             )
 108:         if self.policy.require_public_network:
 109:             try:
 110:                 addresses = {
 111:                     item[4][0]
 112:                     for item in socket.getaddrinfo(parsed.hostname, parsed.port or 443)
 113:                 }
 114:             except socket.gaierror as exc:
 115:                 raise FetchFailure("dns_error", f"Hostname konnte nicht aufgelöst werden: {exc}") from exc
 116:             if not addresses:
 117:                 raise FetchFailure("dns_error", "Hostname lieferte keine Netzwerkadresse.")
 118:             for address in addresses:
 119:                 ip = ipaddress.ip_address(address)
 120:                 if not ip.is_global:
 121:                     raise FetchFailure(
 122:                         "non_public_target",
 123:                         "Nur öffentlich erreichbare Internetadressen sind zulässig.",
 124:                         manual_review=True,
 125:                     )
 126: 
 127:     def _require_robots_permission(self, url: str) -> None:
 128:         self._validate_url(url)
 129:         parsed = parse.urlsplit(url)
 130:         robots_url = parse.urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, parsed.netloc, "/robots.txt", "", ""))
 131:         req = request.Request(robots_url, headers={"User-Agent": self.policy.user_agent})
 132:         redirects = _RedirectRecorder(self._validate_url)
 133:         opener = request.build_opener(redirects)
 134:         try:
 135:             with opener.open(req, timeout=self.policy.timeout_seconds) as response:
 136:                 raw = response.read(1_000_000)
 137:                 encoding = response.headers.get_content_charset() or "utf-8"
 138:                 rules = raw.decode(encoding, errors="replace")
 139:         except error.HTTPError as exc:
 140:             if exc.code == 404:
 141:                 return
 142:             raise FetchFailure(
 143:                 "robots_unavailable",
 144:                 f"robots.txt konnte nicht verlässlich geprüft werden (HTTP {exc.code}).",
 145:                 status_code=exc.code,
 146:                 manual_review=True,
 147:             ) from exc
 148:         except (error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
 149:             raise FetchFailure(
 150:                 "robots_unavailable",
 151:                 f"robots.txt konnte nicht verlässlich geprüft werden: {exc}",
 152:                 manual_review=True,
 153:             ) from exc
 154: 
 155:         parser = robotparser.RobotFileParser()
 156:         parser.set_url(robots_url)
 157:         parser.parse(rules.splitlines())
 158:         if not parser.can_fetch(self.policy.user_agent, url):
 159:             raise FetchFailure(
 160:                 "robots_disallowed",
 161:                 "robots.txt untersagt den Abruf für diesen User-Agent.",
 162:                 manual_review=True,
 163:             )
 164: 
 165:     def _fetch_once(self, url: str) -> FetchResult:
 166:         redirects = _RedirectRecorder(
 167:             self._require_robots_permission if self.policy.respect_robots else lambda _url: None
 168:         )
 169:         opener = request.build_opener(redirects)
 170:         req = request.Request(
 171:             url,
 172:             headers={
 173:                 "User-Agent": self.policy.user_agent,
 174:                 "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1",
 175:                 "Accept-Language": "de,en;q=0.5",
 176:                 "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
 177:             },
 178:         )
 179:         fetched_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 180:         try:
 181:             with opener.open(req, timeout=self.policy.timeout_seconds) as response:
 182:                 body = response.read()
 183:                 status = response.status
 184:                 headers = tuple(response.headers.items())
 185:                 final_url = response.geturl()
 186:                 decoded = self._decode_body(body, response.headers)
 187:         except error.HTTPError as exc:
 188:             body = exc.read()
 189:             headers = tuple(exc.headers.items()) if exc.headers else ()
 190:             raise FetchFailure(
 191:                 "http_error",
 192:                 f"HTTP-Abruf fehlgeschlagen (Status {exc.code}).",
 193:                 status_code=exc.code,
 194:                 headers=headers,
 195:                 body=body,
 196:                 manual_review=exc.code in {401, 403, 407, 429},
 197:             ) from exc
 198:         except (error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
 199:             raise FetchFailure("network_error", f"HTTP-Abruf fehlgeschlagen: {exc}") from exc
 200: 
 201:         block_reason = _detect_block_page(decoded)
 202:         if block_reason:
 203:             raise FetchFailure(
 204:                 "protected_or_login_page",
 205:                 f"Abruf abgebrochen: {block_reason}",
 206:                 status_code=status,
 207:                 headers=headers,
 208:                 body=body,
 209:                 manual_review=True,
 210:             )
 211:         return FetchResult(
 212:             requested_url=url,
 213:             final_url=final_url,
 214:             fetched_at=fetched_at,
 215:             status_code=status,
 216:             headers=headers,
 217:             redirect_chain=tuple(redirects.chain),
 218:             body=body,
 219:             decoded_html=decoded,
 220:         )
 221: 
 222:     @staticmethod
 223:     def _decode_body(body: bytes, headers: Message) -> str:
 224:         content_encoding = (headers.get("Content-Encoding") or "").lower()
 225:         if content_encoding == "gzip":
 226:             body = gzip.decompress(body)
 227:         charset = headers.get_content_charset() or "utf-8"
 228:         return body.decode(charset, errors="replace")

 230: 
 231: def _detect_block_page(html: str) -> str | None:
 232:     sample = html[:500_000].lower()
 233:     captcha_markers = ("g-recaptcha", "hcaptcha", "captcha-container", "cf-chl-")
 234:     if any(marker in sample for marker in captcha_markers) or re.search(
 235:         r"\b(?:verify you are human|captcha)\b", sample
 236:     ):
 237:         return "CAPTCHA oder Bot-Challenge erkannt; manuelle Prüfung erforderlich."
 238:     if re.search(r"<input\b[^>]*\btype\s*=\s*['\"]?password\b", sample):
 239:         return "Login-Seite erkannt; manuelle Prüfung erforderlich."
 240:     if "just a moment" in sample and "cloudflare" in sample:
 241:         return "technische Blockseite erkannt; manuelle Prüfung erforderlich."
 242:     return None

 272:     def _sitemap_urls(self, source_url: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
 273:         parsed = urlsplit(source_url)
 274:         return (urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, parsed.netloc, "/sitemap.xml", "", "")),)
 275: 
 276:     def _read_sitemap(self, sitemap_url: str) -> list[str]:
 277:         try:
 278:             fetched = self.fetcher.fetch(sitemap_url)
 279:             root = etree.fromstring(fetched.body)
 280:         except (FetchFailure, etree.XMLSyntaxError, ValueError):
 281:             return []
 282:         return [str(value).strip() for value in root.xpath("//*[local-name()='loc']/text()") if str(value).strip()]
 283: 
 284:     def _document_findings(self, case: MonitoringCase, pages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
 285:         target = normalize_plain_text(case.clause_text or case.monitoring_target).strip()
 286:         findings: list[dict] = []
 287:         for page in pages:
 288:             lower_identity = f"{page['url']} {page['source']}".casefold()
 289:             is_document = any(term in lower_identity for term in DISCOVERY_TERMS) or page["url"] == canonical_url(case.source_url)
 290:             if not is_document:
 291:                 continue
 292:             text = normalize_plain_text(page["text"]).strip() if page["text"] else ""
 293:             exact = bool(target and target.casefold() in text.casefold())
 294:             similarity = 0.0
 295:             best_quote: str | None = None
 296:             if target and text and not exact:
 297:                 for clause in split_clauses(text):
 298:                     score = SequenceMatcher(None, target.casefold(), clause.text.casefold()).ratio()
 299:                     if score > similarity:
 300:                         similarity, best_quote = score, clause.text
 301:             findings.append(
 302:                 {
 303:                     "url": page["url"],
 304:                     "kind": page["content_type"],
 305:                     "reported_clause_exact": exact,
 306:                     "similarity": round(1.0 if exact else similarity, 3),
 307:                     "candidate_quote": target if exact else best_quote,
 308:                     "artifact_path": page["artifact_path"],
 309:                     "sha256": page["sha256"],
 310:                 }
 311:             )
 312:         return findings
 313: 
 314:     def _inspect_elements(
 315:         self, case: MonitoringCase, pages: list[dict], destination: Path
 316:     ) -> tuple[list[dict], list[str]]:
 317:         if self.dom_inspector is None:
 318:             return [], ["Playwright-DOM-Prüfung ist nicht konfiguriert."]
 319:         destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 320:         relevant = [
 321:             page for page in pages
 322:             if page["content_type"] == "html" and (
 323:                 page["url"] == canonical_url(case.source_url)
 324:                 or any(term in f"{page['url']} {page['source']}".casefold() for term in DISCOVERY_TERMS)
 325:             )
 326:         ][: self.policy.max_dom_pages]
 327:         findings: list[dict] = []
 328:         reasons: list[str] = []
 329:         for index, page in enumerate(relevant, start=1):
 330:             try:
 331:                 capture = self.dom_inspector(
 332:                     page["url"],
 333:                     destination / f"{index:03d}-dom.json",
 334:                     label=case.element_label or case.monitoring_target,
 335:                     function=case.element_function or case.monitoring_target,
 336:                 )
 337:             except Exception as exc:
 338:                 reasons.append(f"DOM-Prüfung für {page['url']} fehlgeschlagen: {exc}")
 339:                 continue
 340:             matches = list(capture.matching_elements)
 341:             state = _element_state(case, matches, capture.safe_path_status)
 342:             if state == "manuelle_pruefung_erforderlich":
 343:                 reasons.append(
 344:                     f"Die Funktion des Elements auf {page['url']} lässt sich ohne Außenwirkung nicht abschließend prüfen."
 345:                 )
 346:             findings.append(
 347:                 {
 348:                     "url": page["url"],
 349:                     "state": state,
 350:                     "matches": matches,
 351:                     "safe_path_status": capture.safe_path_status,
 352:                     "safe_path": capture.safe_path,
 353:                     "blocked_requests": list(capture.blocked_requests),
 354:                     "dom_artifact_path": capture.path,
 355:                     "screenshot_path": capture.screenshot_path,
 356:                     "sha256": capture.sha256,
 357:                 }
 358:             )
 359:             reasons.extend(capture.manual_review_reasons)
 360:         return findings, reasons

 362:     def _has_history(self, case_id: str) -> bool:
 363:         directory = self.store / case_id
 364:         return directory.is_dir() and any(directory.glob("*/result.json"))

 366: 
 367: def _monitoring_status(
 368:     case: MonitoringCase,
 369:     documents: list[dict],
 370:     elements: list[dict],
 371:     complete: bool,
 372:     has_history: bool,
 373: ) -> str:
 374:     if not complete:
 375:         return "pruefung_unvollstaendig"
 376:     if case.violation_type == "klausel":
 377:         exact = [item for item in documents if item["reported_clause_exact"]]
 378:         similar = [item for item in documents if not item["reported_clause_exact"] and item["similarity"] >= 0.72]
 379:         if exact:
 380:             if not has_history:
 381:                 return "referenzzustand_dokumentiert"
 382:             if any(item["url"] != canonical_url(case.source_url) for item in exact):
 383:                 return "kerngleich_wiederaufgetreten"
 384:             return "unveraendert_fortbestehend"
 385:         if similar:
 386:             return "unsicher"
 387:         return "beseitigt"
 388:     if not elements:
 389:         return "pruefung_unvollstaendig"
 390:     if any(item["state"] == "manuelle_pruefung_erforderlich" for item in elements):
 391:         return "unsicher"
 392:     violation_persists = not any(item["state"] == "gefunden" for item in elements)
 393:     if violation_persists:
 394:         return "referenzzustand_dokumentiert" if not has_history else "unveraendert_fortbestehend"
 395:     return "beseitigt"
 396: 
 397: 
 398: def _element_state(
 399:     case: MonitoringCase, matches: list[dict], safe_path_status: str
 400: ) -> str:
 401:     if not matches:
 402:         return "nicht_gefunden_im_pruefumfang"
 403:     accessible = [
 404:         item for item in matches
 405:         if item.get("visible") and not item.get("disabled") and not item.get("obscured")
 406:         and str(item.get("accessible_name") or "").strip()
 407:     ]
 408:     if not accessible:
 409:         return "vorhanden_aber_fehlerhaft"
 410:     if case.element_error == "falsches_ziel":
 411:         expected = (case.element_function or "").strip().casefold()
 412:         target_values = [str(item.get("href") or "").casefold() for item in accessible]
 413:         if expected.startswith(("http://", "https://")) or expected.startswith("/"):
 414:             return "gefunden" if any(expected in target for target in target_values) else "vorhanden_aber_fehlerhaft"
 415:         return "manuelle_pruefung_erforderlich"
 416:     if case.element_error == "zusaetzliche_huerde":
 417:         return (
 418:             "gefunden"
 419:             if safe_path_status == "gleichurspruengliches_ziel_dokumentiert"
 420:             else "manuelle_pruefung_erforderlich"
 421:         )
 422:     return "gefunden"
 423: 
 424: 
 425: def canonical_url(value: str) -> str:
 426:     parsed = urlsplit(value)
 427:     query = urlencode(
 428:         sorted((key, val) for key, val in parse_qsl(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True) if key.casefold() not in TRACKING_PARAMETERS)
 429:     )
 430:     path = re.sub(r"/{2,}", "/", parsed.path or "/")
 431:     return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme.lower(), parsed.netloc.lower(), path, query, ""))
 432: 
 433: 
 434: def _allowed(url: str, allowed_hosts: set[str]) -> bool:
 435:     parsed = urlsplit(url)
 436:     return parsed.scheme in {"http", "https"} and parsed.hostname in allowed_hosts and not parsed.username
 437: 
 438: 
 439: def _priority(url: str, label: str) -> int:
 440:     haystack = f"{url} {label}".casefold()
 441:     return sum(10 for term in DISCOVERY_TERMS if term in haystack)
 442: 
 443: 
 444: def _links(raw_html: str, base_url: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
 445:     try:
 446:         document = html.document_fromstring(raw_html)
 447:     except (etree.ParserError, ValueError):
 448:         return []
 449:     result: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
 450:     for anchor in document.xpath("//a[@href]"):
 451:         href = str(anchor.get("href") or "").strip()
 452:         if not href or href.startswith(("mailto:", "tel:", "javascript:")):
 453:             continue
 454:         absolute = canonical_url(urljoin(base_url, href))
 455:         label = " ".join(anchor.itertext()).strip()
 456:         result.append((absolute, label))
 457:     return result
 458: 
 459: 
 460: def _is_pdf(headers: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...], body: bytes, url: str) -> bool:
 461:     content_type = next((value for key, value in headers if key.lower() == "content-type"), "")
 462:     return "application/pdf" in content_type.lower() or body.startswith(b"%PDF-") or urlsplit(url).path.lower().endswith(".pdf")
 463: 
 464: 
 465: def _extract_document_text(fetched, extension: str) -> str:  # noqa: ANN001
 466:     if extension == ".pdf":
 467:         try:
 468:             from io import BytesIO
 469:             from pypdf import PdfReader
 470: 
 471:             return normalize_plain_text("\n".join(page.extract_text() or "" for page in PdfReader(BytesIO(fetched.body)).pages))
 472:         except Exception:
 473:             return ""
 474:     try:
 475:         return normalize_html(fetched.decoded_html, NormalizationConfig()).text
 476:     except Exception:
 477:         try:
 478:             document = html.document_fromstring(fetched.decoded_html)
 479:             return normalize_plain_text(" ".join(document.itertext()))
 480:         except Exception:
 481:             return ""
 482: 
 483: 
 484: def _write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
 485:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 486:     path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

 218: def validate_case_input(value: dict) -> dict:
 219:     required = (
 220:         "fall_id",
 221:         "domain",
 222:         "source_url",
 223:         "violation_type",
 224:         "description",
 225:         "tenor_element",
 226:         "monitoring_target",
 227:         "relevant_page_types",
 228:     )
 229:     cleaned = dict(value)
 230:     for field in required[:-1]:
 231:         if not isinstance(cleaned.get(field), str) or not cleaned[field].strip():
 232:             raise MonitoringCaseError(f"Pflichtfeld {field!r} fehlt.")
 233:         cleaned[field] = cleaned[field].strip()
 234:     page_types = cleaned.get("relevant_page_types")
 235:     if not isinstance(page_types, list) or not page_types or not all(
 236:         isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in page_types
 237:     ):
 238:         raise MonitoringCaseError("Mindestens ein relevanter Seitentyp ist erforderlich.")
 239:     cleaned["relevant_page_types"] = [item.strip() for item in page_types]
 240:     if cleaned["violation_type"] not in VIOLATION_TYPES:
 241:         raise MonitoringCaseError("Verstoßtyp muss 'klausel' oder 'element' sein.")
 242: 
 243:     domain_host = _host(cleaned["domain"])
 244:     source_host = _host(cleaned["source_url"])
 245:     allowed = cleaned.get("allowed_subdomains", [])
 246:     if not isinstance(allowed, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in allowed):
 247:         raise MonitoringCaseError("allowed_subdomains muss eine Liste von Hostnamen sein.")
 248:     allowed_hosts = tuple(sorted({_host(item) for item in allowed if item.strip()}))
 249:     if source_host != domain_host and source_host not in allowed_hosts:
 250:         raise MonitoringCaseError("Fundstellen-URL muss zur Domain oder freigegebenen Subdomain gehören.")
 251:     cleaned["domain"] = domain_host
 252:     cleaned["allowed_subdomains"] = list(allowed_hosts)
 253: 
 254:     if cleaned["violation_type"] == "klausel":
 255:         clause_text = str(cleaned.get("clause_text") or "").strip()
 256:         if not clause_text:
 257:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Bei Klauselverstößen ist der beanstandete Wortlaut erforderlich.")
 258:         cleaned["clause_text"] = clause_text
 259:         cleaned.update(element_label=None, element_function=None, element_error=None)
 260:     else:
 261:         for field in ("element_label", "element_function", "element_error"):
 262:             if not isinstance(cleaned.get(field), str) or not cleaned[field].strip():
 263:                 raise MonitoringCaseError(f"Bei Elementverstößen ist {field!r} erforderlich.")
 264:             cleaned[field] = cleaned[field].strip()
 265:         if cleaned["element_error"] not in ELEMENT_ERRORS:
 266:             raise MonitoringCaseError("Unbekannte Fehlerart für das erwartete Element.")
 267:         cleaned["clause_text"] = None
 268:     return cleaned

 271: def _host(value: str) -> str:

  47: def changed_excerpts(before: str, after: str, *, context_lines: int = 2, max_chars: int = 6000) -> tuple[str, str]:
  48:     """Build small, deterministic before/after excerpts without sending raw HTML."""
  49:     before_lines = before.splitlines()
  50:     after_lines = after.splitlines()
  51:     matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=before_lines, b=after_lines, autojunk=False)
  52:     before_parts: list[str] = []
  53:     after_parts: list[str] = []
  54:     for tag, old_start, old_end, new_start, new_end in matcher.get_opcodes():
  55:         if tag == "equal":
  56:             continue
  57:         old_from = max(0, old_start - context_lines)
  58:         old_to = min(len(before_lines), old_end + context_lines)
  59:         new_from = max(0, new_start - context_lines)
  60:         new_to = min(len(after_lines), new_end + context_lines)
  61:         before_parts.append("\n".join(before_lines[old_from:old_to]))
  62:         after_parts.append("\n".join(after_lines[new_from:new_to]))
  63:     before_excerpt = "\n[…]\n".join(part for part in before_parts if part).strip()
  64:     after_excerpt = "\n[…]\n".join(part for part in after_parts if part).strip()
  65:     if not before_excerpt and not after_excerpt:
  66:         raise ValueError("Für die Modellprüfung wurde keine geänderte Passage gefunden.")

 147:                 and _matches_excluded_case(lowered, item["text"].casefold())

 149:             None,
 150:         )

 154:                 excluded["id"],
 155:                 new,
 156:                 "Die neue Klausel beschreibt einen ausdrücklich nicht erfassten Gegenfall.",
 157:             )
 158: 
 159:         covered = next(
 160:             (
 161:                 item for item in elements
 162:                 if item["typ"] == "kerngleich_umfasst"
 163:                 and _matches_covered_case(lowered, item["text"].casefold())
 164:             ),
 165:             None,
 166:         )

 171:                 new,

 173:             )

 175:             "unsicher",
 176:             elements[0]["id"],
 177:             new,

 261: def aggregate_clause_findings(
 262:     tenor: dict[str, Any], findings: tuple[ClassifiedClausePair, ...]
 263: ) -> LegalAssessment:
 264:     classes = [item.result.classification for item in findings]
 265:     if "kerngleich" in classes:
 266:         result = "kerngleich_umfasst"
 267:     elif "unsicher" in classes or not classes:
 268:         result = "unklar"
 269:     else:
 270:         result = "nicht_umfasst"
 271:     levels = {"hoch": 0.9, "mittel": 0.7, "niedrig": 0.4}
 272:     confidence = min((levels[item.result.confidence] for item in findings), default=0.4)
 273:     facts = tuple(
 274:         f"{item.result.classification}: {item.result.evidence_quote}"
 275:         for item in findings
 276:         if item.result.evidence_quote
 277:     ) or ("Keine belastbare geänderte Klausel ermittelt.",)
 278:     reasoning = " ".join(item.result.reasoning for item in findings)
 279:     sources = tuple(
 280:         LegalSource(str(source), "nicht_verifiziert")
 281:         for source in tenor.get("rechtsgrundlage", [])
 282:     )
 283:     return LegalAssessment(
 284:         ergebnis=result,
 285:         begruendung=reasoning or "Klauselscharfe Vorprüfung ohne abschließende Rechtsentscheidung.",
 286:         tatsachenbasis=facts,
 287:         rechtsquellen=sources,
 288:         staerkstes_gegenargument=(
 289:             "Die tatsächlichen Umstände können von der textlichen Klauselwirkung abweichen."
 290:         ),
 291:         unsicherheit="Jede Klauselklassifikation muss durch einen Menschen freigegeben werden.",
 292:         confidence=confidence,
 293:     )

 296: def _matches_excluded_case(value: str, excluded_text: str) -> bool:
 297:     has_date = bool(
 298:         re.search(r"\b\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{2,4}\b|\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b", value)
 299:     )
 300:     has_terms = "belegbar" in excluded_text or "enddatum" in excluded_text
 301:     return has_date and has_terms

 303: 
 304: def _matches_covered_case(value: str, covered_text: str) -> bool:
 305:     if "countdown" in covered_text:
 306:         return "countdown" in value or (":" in value and any(char.isdigit() for char in value))
 307:     if "restmengen" in covered_text:
 308:         return any(term in value for term in ("nur noch", "stück", "verfügbar", "lager"))
 309:     if "nur heute" in covered_text:
 310:         return "nur heute" in value
 311:     return covered_text in value

  47: def changed_excerpts(before: str, after: str, *, context_lines: int = 2, max_chars: int = 6000) -> tuple[str, str]:
  48:     """Build small, deterministic before/after excerpts without sending raw HTML."""
  49:     before_lines = before.splitlines()
  50:     after_lines = after.splitlines()
  51:     matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=before_lines, b=after_lines, autojunk=False)
  52:     before_parts: list[str] = []
  53:     after_parts: list[str] = []
  54:     for tag, old_start, old_end, new_start, new_end in matcher.get_opcodes():
  55:         if tag == "equal":
  56:             continue
  57:         old_from = max(0, old_start - context_lines)
  58:         old_to = min(len(before_lines), old_end + context_lines)
  59:         new_from = max(0, new_start - context_lines)
  60:         new_to = min(len(after_lines), new_end + context_lines)
  61:         before_parts.append("\n".join(before_lines[old_from:old_to]))
  62:         after_parts.append("\n".join(after_lines[new_from:new_to]))
  63:     before_excerpt = "\n[…]\n".join(part for part in before_parts if part).strip()
  64:     after_excerpt = "\n[…]\n".join(part for part in after_parts if part).strip()
  65:     if not before_excerpt and not after_excerpt:
  66:         raise ValueError("Für die Modellprüfung wurde keine geänderte Passage gefunden.")
  67:     return _truncate_excerpt(before_excerpt, max_chars), _truncate_excerpt(after_excerpt, max_chars)
  68: 
  69: 
  70: def _truncate_excerpt(value: str, max_chars: int) -> str:
  71:     if len(value) <= max_chars:
  72:         return value
  73:     return value[: max_chars - 20].rstrip() + "\n[… gekürzt …]"

 183: def analyze_clause_pairs_and_store(
 184:     tenor: dict[str, Any],
 185:     pairs: tuple[ClausePair, ...],
 186:     analyzer: ClauseAnalyzer,
 187:     output_directory: str | Path,
 188: ) -> ClauseAnalysisRun:
 189:     output_directory = Path(output_directory).resolve()
 190:     output_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 191:     input_path = output_directory / "clause-model-input.json"
 192:     output_path = output_directory / "clause-model-output.json"
 193:     metadata_path = output_directory / "clause-analysis-metadata.json"
 194:     elements = tenor_elements_from_tenor(tenor)
 195:     inputs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
 196:     findings: list[ClassifiedClausePair] = []
 197:     for pair in pairs:
 198:         model_input = build_clause_input(tenor, pair, elements)
 199:         inputs.append(model_input)
 200:         try:
 201:             raw = analyzer.analyze(model_input)
 202:         except Exception as exc:
 203:             raw = {
 204:                 "classification": "unsicher",
 205:                 "tenor_element_id": elements[0]["id"],
 206:                 "confidence": "niedrig",
 207:                 "evidence_quote": _short_quote(
 208:                     pair.current.text if pair.current else pair.previous.text
 209:                 ),
 210:                 "reasoning": f"Modellaufruf fehlgeschlagen: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
 211:             }
 212:         validated = validate_clause_classification(
 213:             raw,
 214:             elements,
 215:             pair.previous.text if pair.previous else None,
 216:             pair.current.text if pair.current else None,
 217:         )
 218:         findings.append(
 219:             ClassifiedClausePair(
 220:                 previous_ordinal=pair.previous.ordinal if pair.previous else None,
 221:                 current_ordinal=pair.current.ordinal if pair.current else None,
 222:                 previous_text=pair.previous.text if pair.previous else None,
 223:                 current_text=pair.current.text if pair.current else None,
 224:                 similarity=pair.similarity,
 225:                 result=validated,
 226:             )
 227:         )
 228:     assessment = aggregate_clause_findings(tenor, tuple(findings))
 229:     valid = all(item.result.validation_error is None for item in findings)
 230:     input_payload = {
 231:         "prompt_version": CLAUSE_PROMPT_VERSION,
 232:         "prompt_sha256": CLAUSE_PROMPT_SHA256,
 233:         "pairs": inputs,
 234:     }
 235:     output_payload = {
 236:         "schema_valid": valid,
 237:         "classifications": [item.to_dict() for item in findings],
 238:         "aggregate_assessment": assessment.to_dict(),
 239:     }
 240:     _write_json(input_path, input_payload)
 241:     _write_json(output_path, output_payload)
 242:     _write_json(metadata_path, {
 243:         "mode": analyzer.mode,
 244:         "model": analyzer.model,
 245:         "prompt_version": CLAUSE_PROMPT_VERSION,
 246:         "prompt_sha256": CLAUSE_PROMPT_SHA256,
 247:         "schema_valid": valid,
 248:         "pair_count": len(findings),
 249:     })
 250:     return ClauseAnalysisRun(
 251:         valid=valid,
 252:         mode=analyzer.mode,
 253:         model=analyzer.model,
 254:         findings=tuple(findings),
 255:         assessment=assessment,
 256:         input_path=str(input_path),
 257:         output_path=str(output_path),
 258:     )

 261: def aggregate_clause_findings(
 262:     tenor: dict[str, Any], findings: tuple[ClassifiedClausePair, ...]
 263: ) -> LegalAssessment:
 264:     classes = [item.result.classification for item in findings]
 265:     if "kerngleich" in classes:
 266:         result = "kerngleich_umfasst"
 267:     elif "unsicher" in classes or not classes:
 268:         result = "unklar"
 269:     else:
 270:         result = "nicht_umfasst"
 271:     levels = {"hoch": 0.9, "mittel": 0.7, "niedrig": 0.4}
 272:     confidence = min((levels[item.result.confidence] for item in findings), default=0.4)
 273:     facts = tuple(
 274:         f"{item.result.classification}: {item.result.evidence_quote}"
 275:         for item in findings
 276:         if item.result.evidence_quote
 277:     ) or ("Keine belastbare geänderte Klausel ermittelt.",)
 278:     reasoning = " ".join(item.result.reasoning for item in findings)
 279:     sources = tuple(
 280:         LegalSource(str(source), "nicht_verifiziert")
 281:         for source in tenor.get("rechtsgrundlage", [])
 282:     )
 283:     return LegalAssessment(
 284:         ergebnis=result,
 285:         begruendung=reasoning or "Klauselscharfe Vorprüfung ohne abschließende Rechtsentscheidung.",
 286:         tatsachenbasis=facts,
 287:         rechtsquellen=sources,
 288:         staerkstes_gegenargument=(
 289:             "Die tatsächlichen Umstände können von der textlichen Klauselwirkung abweichen."
 290:         ),
 291:         unsicherheit="Jede Klauselklassifikation muss durch einen Menschen freigegeben werden.",
 292:         confidence=confidence,
 293:     )

 296: def _matches_excluded_case(value: str, excluded_text: str) -> bool:
 297:     has_date = bool(
 298:         re.search(r"\b\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{2,4}\b|\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b", value)
 299:     )
 300:     has_terms = "belegbar" in excluded_text or "enddatum" in excluded_text
 301:     return has_date and has_terms
 302: 
 303: 
 304: def _matches_covered_case(value: str, covered_text: str) -> bool:
 305:     if "countdown" in covered_text:
 306:         return "countdown" in value or (":" in value and any(char.isdigit() for char in value))
 307:     if "restmengen" in covered_text:
 308:         return any(term in value for term in ("nur noch", "stück", "verfügbar", "lager"))
 309:     if "nur heute" in covered_text:
 310:         return "nur heute" in value
 311:     return covered_text in value
 312:

 314: def _result(
 315:     classification: str,
 316:     element_id: str,
 317:     source: str | None,
 318:     reasoning: str,
 319:     *,
 320:     confidence: str = "hoch",
 321: ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 322:     return {
 323:         "classification": classification,
 324:         "tenor_element_id": element_id,
 325:         "confidence": confidence,
 326:         "evidence_quote": _short_quote(source),
 327:         "reasoning": reasoning,
 328:     }
 329:

 331: def _short_quote(value: str | None, max_chars: int = 240) -> str:
 332:     if not value:
 333:         return "Kein aktueller Klauseltext vorhanden."
 334:     return value[:max_chars]

  47: def changed_excerpts(before: str, after: str, *, context_lines: int = 2, max_chars: int = 6000) -> tuple[str, str]:
  48:     """Build small, deterministic before/after excerpts without sending raw HTML."""
  49:     before_lines = before.splitlines()
  50:     after_lines = after.splitlines()
  51:     matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=before_lines, b=after_lines, autojunk=False)
  52:     before_parts: list[str] = []
  53:     after_parts: list[str] = []
  54:     for tag, old_start, old_end, new_start, new_end in matcher.get_opcodes():
  55:         if tag == "equal":
  56:             continue
  57:         old_from = max(0, old_start - context_lines)
  58:         old_to = min(len(before_lines), old_end + context_lines)
  59:         new_from = max(0, new_start - context_lines)
  60:         new_to = min(len(after_lines), new_end + context_lines)
  61:         before_parts.append("\n".join(before_lines[old_from:old_to]))
  62:         after_parts.append("\n".join(after_lines[new_from:new_to]))
  63:     before_excerpt = "\n[…]\n".join(part for part in before_parts if part).strip()
  64:     after_excerpt = "\n[…]\n".join(part for part in after_parts if part).strip()
  65:     if not before_excerpt and not after_excerpt:
  66:         raise ValueError("Für die Modellprüfung wurde keine geänderte Passage gefunden.")
  67:     return _truncate_excerpt(before_excerpt, max_chars), _truncate_excerpt(after_excerpt, max_chars)

  47: def changed_excerpts(before: str, after: str, *, context_lines: int = 2, max_chars: int = 6000) -> tuple[str, str]:
  48:     """Build small, deterministic before/after excerpts without sending raw HTML."""
  49:     before_lines = before.splitlines()
  50:     after_lines = after.splitlines()
  51:     matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=before_lines, b=after_lines, autojunk=False)
  52:     before_parts: list[str] = []
  53:     after_parts: list[str] = []
  54:     for tag, old_start, old_end, new_start, new_end in matcher.get_opcodes():
  55:         if tag == "equal":
  56:             continue
  57:         old_from = max(0, old_start - context_lines)
  58:         old_to = min(len(before_lines), old_end + context_lines)
  59:         new_from = max(0, new_start - context_lines)
  60:         new_to = min(len(after_lines), new_end + context_lines)
  61:         before_parts.append("\n".join(before_lines[old_from:old_to]))
  62:         after_parts.append("\n".join(after_lines[new_from:new_to]))
  63:     before_excerpt = "\n[…]\n".join(part for part in before_parts if part).strip()
  64:     after_excerpt = "\n[…]\n".join(part for part in after_parts if part).strip()
  65:     if not before_excerpt and not after_excerpt:
  66:         raise ValueError("Für die Modellprüfung wurde keine geänderte Passage gefunden.")
  67:     return _truncate_excerpt(before_excerpt, max_chars), _truncate_excerpt(after_excerpt, max_chars)

 183: def analyze_clause_pairs_and_store(
 184:     tenor: dict[str, Any],
 185:     pairs: tuple[ClausePair, ...],
 186:     analyzer: ClauseAnalyzer,
 187:     output_directory: str | Path,
 188: ) -> ClauseAnalysisRun:
 189:     output_directory = Path(output_directory).resolve()
 190:     output_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 191:     input_path = output_directory / "clause-model-input.json"
 192:     output_path = output_directory / "clause-model-output.json"
 193:     metadata_path = output_directory / "clause-analysis-metadata.json"
 194:     elements = tenor_elements_from_tenor(tenor)
 195:     inputs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
 196:     findings: list[ClassifiedClausePair] = []
 197:     for pair in pairs:
 198:         model_input = build_clause_input(tenor, pair, elements)
 199:         inputs.append(model_input)
 200:         try:
 201:             raw = analyzer.analyze(model_input)
 202:         except Exception as exc:
 203:             raw = {
 204:                 "classification": "unsicher",
 205:                 "tenor_element_id": elements[0]["id"],
 206:                 "confidence": "niedrig",
 207:                 "evidence_quote": _short_quote(
 208:                     pair.current.text if pair.current else pair.previous.text
 209:                 ),
 210:                 "reasoning": f"Modellaufruf fehlgeschlagen: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
 211:             }
 212:         validated = validate_clause_classification(
 213:             raw,
 214:             elements,
 215:             pair.previous.text if pair.previous else None,
 216:             pair.current.text if pair.current else None,
 217:         )
 218:         findings.append(
 219:             ClassifiedClausePair(
 220:                 previous_ordinal=pair.previous.ordinal if pair.previous else None,
 221:                 current_ordinal=pair.current.ordinal if pair.current else None,
 222:                 previous_text=pair.previous.text if pair.previous else None,
 223:                 current_text=pair.current.text if pair.current else None,
 224:                 similarity=pair.similarity,
 225:                 result=validated,
 226:             )
 227:         )
 228:     assessment = aggregate_clause_findings(tenor, tuple(findings))
 229:     valid = all(item.result.validation_error is None for item in findings)
 230:     input_payload = {
 231:         "prompt_version": CLAUSE_PROMPT_VERSION,
 232:         "prompt_sha256": CLAUSE_PROMPT_SHA256,
 233:         "pairs": inputs,
 234:     }
 235:     output_payload = {
 236:         "schema_valid": valid,
 237:         "classifications": [item.to_dict() for item in findings],
 238:         "aggregate_assessment": assessment.to_dict(),
 239:     }
 240:     _write_json(input_path, input_payload)
 241:     _write_json(output_path, output_payload)
 242:     _write_json(metadata_path, {
 243:         "mode": analyzer.mode,
 244:         "model": analyzer.model,
 245:         "prompt_version": CLAUSE_PROMPT_VERSION,
 246:         "prompt_sha256": CLAUSE_PROMPT_SHA256,
 247:         "schema_valid": valid,
 248:         "pair_count": len(findings),
 249:     })
 250:     return ClauseAnalysisRun(
 251:         valid=valid,
 252:         mode=analyzer.mode,
 253:         model=analyzer.model,
 254:         findings=tuple(findings),
 255:         assessment=assessment,
 256:         input_path=str(input_path),
 257:         output_path=str(output_path),
 258:     )

 260: 
 261: def aggregate_clause_findings(
 262:     tenor: dict[str, Any], findings: tuple[ClassifiedClausePair, ...]
 263: ) -> LegalAssessment:
 264:     classes = [item.result.classification for item in findings]
 265:     if "kerngleich" in classes:
 266:         result = "kerngleich_umfasst"
 267:     elif "unsicher" in classes or not classes:
 268:         result = "unklar"
 269:     else:
 270:         result = "nicht_umfasst"
 271:     levels = {"hoch": 0.9, "mittel": 0.7, "niedrig": 0.4}
 272:     confidence = min((levels[item.result.confidence] for item in findings), default=0.4)
 273:     facts = tuple(
 274:         f"{item.result.classification}: {item.result.evidence_quote}"
 275:         for item in findings
 276:         if item.result.evidence_quote
 277:     ) or ("Keine belastbare geänderte Klausel ermittelt.",)
 278:     reasoning = " ".join(item.result.reasoning for item in findings)
 279:     sources = tuple(
 280:         LegalSource(str(source), "nicht_verifiziert")
 281:         for source in tenor.get("rechtsgrundlage", [])
 282:     )
 283:     return LegalAssessment(
 284:         ergebnis=result,
 285:         begruendung=reasoning or "Klauselscharfe Vorprüfung ohne abschließende Rechtsentscheidung.",
 286:         tatsachenbasis=facts,
 287:         rechtsquellen=sources,
 288:         staerkstes_gegenargument=(
 289:             "Die tatsächlichen Umstände können von der textlichen Klauselwirkung abweichen."
 290:         ),
 291:         unsicherheit="Jede Klauselklassifikation muss durch einen Menschen freigegeben werden.",
 292:         confidence=confidence,
 293:     )
 294: 
 295: 
 296: def _matches_excluded_case(value: str, excluded_text: str) -> bool:
 297:     has_date = bool(
 298:         re.search(r"\b\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{2,4}\b|\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b", value)
 299:     )
 300:     has_terms = "belegbar" in excluded_text or "enddatum" in excluded_text
 301:     return has_date and has_terms
 302: 
 303: 
 304: def _matches_covered_case(value: str, covered_text: str) -> bool:
 305:     if "countdown" in covered_text:
 306:         return "countdown" in value or (":" in value and any(char.isdigit() for char in value))
 307:     if "restmengen" in covered_text:
 308:         return any(term in value for term in ("nur noch", "stück", "verfügbar", "lager"))
 309:     if "nur heute" in covered_text:
 310:         return "nur heute" in value
 311:     return covered_text in value
 312: 
 313: 
 314: def _result(
 315:     classification: str,
 316:     element_id: str,
 317:     source: str | None,
 318:     reasoning: str,
 319:     *,
 320:     confidence: str = "hoch",
 321: ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 322:     return {
 323:         "classification": classification,
 324:         "tenor_element_id": element_id,
 325:         "confidence": confidence,
 326:         "evidence_quote": _short_quote(source),
 327:         "reasoning": reasoning,
 328:     }
 329: 
 330: 
 331: def _short_quote(value: str | None, max_chars: int = 240) -> str:
 332:     if not value:
 333:         return "Kein aktueller Klauseltext vorhanden."
 334:     return value[:max_chars]

 340:         encoding="utf-8",
 341:         newline="\n",
 342:     )

 184:                         if run.steps[earlier] in {"waiting", "active"}:
 185:                             run.steps[earlier] = "success"

 189:             url = self._runs[run_id].url
 190:             case_id = (self._runs[run_id].monitoring_result or {}).get("case_id")
 191:         try:
 192:             if case_id and self.case_repository is not None and self.domain_monitor is not None:
 193:                 domain_result = self.domain_monitor.run(self.case_repository.get(case_id), progress)
 194:                 result = None
 195:             else:
 196:                 domain_result = None

 198:             with self._lock:
 199:                 run = self._runs[run_id]

 201:                     run.status = domain_result.status
 202:                     run.message = f"Fallbezogenes Monitoring abgeschlossen: {domain_result.status}."
 203:                     run.monitoring_result = domain_result.to_dict()
 204:                     run.result_available = True

 206:                         run.steps[step] = "success"
 207:                     for step in ("anthropic", "warc", "manifest", "timestamp"):

 214:                     if result.step_states:

 216:                 reached = [step for step in PIPELINE_STEPS if run.steps[step] != "skipped"]

 218:         except Exception as exc:

 128:         self,

 132:         domain_monitor: CaseDomainMonitor | None = None,
 133:     ) -> None:

 137:         self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="muclegal-run")
 138:         self._lock = threading.Lock()

 142:     def start(self, url: str | None = None, *, case_id: str | None = None) -> RunState:
 143:         with self._lock:
 144:             if self._active_run_id:
 145:                 active = self._runs[self._active_run_id]
 146:                 if active.status not in TERMINAL_RUN_STATUSES:
 147:                     raise RuntimeError("Es läuft bereits eine Prüfung.")
 148:             if self.case_repository is not None:
 149:                 if not case_id or url:
 150:                     raise ValueError("Der Monitoringlauf erwartet ausschließlich eine freigegebene case_id.")
 151:                 try:
 152:                     monitoring_case = self.case_repository.get(case_id)
 153:                 except KeyError as exc:
 154:                     raise ValueError("Monitoringfall nicht gefunden.") from exc
 155:                 if not monitoring_case.approved:
 156:                     raise PermissionError("Monitoring startet erst nach menschlicher Freigabe des Falls.")
 157:                 target_url = monitoring_case.source_url
 158:             else:
 159:                 if not url:
 160:                     raise ValueError("Eine Webadresse ist erforderlich.")
 161:                 target_url = url.strip()
 162:             run = RunState(run_id=uuid.uuid4().hex, url=target_url)
 163:             run.monitoring_result = {"case_id": case_id} if case_id else None
 164:             self._runs[run.run_id] = run
 165:             self._active_run_id = run.run_id
 166:             self._executor.submit(self._execute, run.run_id)
 167:             return RunState(**run.to_dict())
 168: 
 169:     def get(self, run_id: str) -> RunState | None:
 170:         with self._lock:
 171:             run = self._runs.get(run_id)
 172:             return RunState(**run.to_dict()) if run else None
 173: 
 174:     def _execute(self, run_id: str) -> None:
 175:         def progress(step: str, message: str) -> None:
 176:             with self._lock:
 177:                 run = self._runs[run_id]
 178:                 run.status = "running"
 179:                 run.current_step = step
 180:                 run.message = message
 181:                 if step in PIPELINE_STEPS:
 182:                     step_index = PIPELINE_STEPS.index(step)
 183:                     for earlier in PIPELINE_STEPS[:step_index]:
 184:                         if run.steps[earlier] in {"waiting", "active"}:
 185:                             run.steps[earlier] = "success"
 186:                     run.steps[step] = "active"
 187: 
 188:         with self._lock:
 189:             url = self._runs[run_id].url
 190:             case_id = (self._runs[run_id].monitoring_result or {}).get("case_id")
 191:         try:
 192:             if case_id and self.case_repository is not None and self.domain_monitor is not None:
 193:                 domain_result = self.domain_monitor.run(self.case_repository.get(case_id), progress)
 194:                 result = None
 195:             else:
 196:                 domain_result = None
 197:                 result = self.workflow.run(url, progress)
 198:             with self._lock:
 199:                 run = self._runs[run_id]
 200:                 if domain_result is not None:
 201:                     run.status = domain_result.status
 202:                     run.message = f"Fallbezogenes Monitoring abgeschlossen: {domain_result.status}."
 203:                     run.monitoring_result = domain_result.to_dict()
 204:                     run.result_available = True
 205:                     for step in ("fetch", "normalize", "screenshot", "compare"):
 206:                         run.steps[step] = "success"
 207:                     for step in ("anthropic", "warc", "manifest", "timestamp"):
 208:                         run.steps[step] = "skipped"
 209:                 else:
 210:                     assert result is not None
 211:                     run.status = result.status
 212:                     run.message = result.message
 213:                     run.result_available = result.case_path is not None
 214:                     if result.step_states:
 215:                         run.steps = dict(result.step_states)
 216:                 reached = [step for step in PIPELINE_STEPS if run.steps[step] != "skipped"]
 217:                 run.current_step = reached[-1] if reached else "compare"
 218:         except Exception as exc:
 219:             with self._lock:
 220:                 run = self._runs[run_id]
 221:                 run.status = "failed"
 222:                 if run.current_step in PIPELINE_STEPS:
 223:                     run.steps[run.current_step] = "failed"
 224:                 run.message = str(exc)
 225:         finally:
 226:             with self._lock:
 227:                 if self._active_run_id == run_id:
 228:                     self._active_run_id = None

   9: CLASSIFICATIONS = {"beseitigt", "kerngleich", "neuer_sachverhalt", "unsicher"}
  10: CONFIDENCE_LEVELS = {"hoch", "mittel", "niedrig"}
  11: REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
